narrative:
MoraBanc employs 584 people across Andorra, Spain, Switzerland and the US — 30% more than three years ago. Staff costs rose 26% to EUR 60.4M in FY2025 as Banco Europeo de Finanzas and Tressis joined the group.

The roster is weighted to the client front office: 125 private bankers and investment advisers in Andorra, 140 international wealth advisers at Tressis, Boreal and Mora Capital, and 105 branch and corporate relationship staff. Control functions (risk, compliance and AML) have 50 people, and the Spanish licence is adding review volume.

Key risk: three senior private bankers with about EUR 120M of client AUM are flagged as departure risks.
